title: Dreamer VNext TI-429 executable matrix
binary: mixed: release-native, mock-native, manual, web/tablet. Nothing in this file is device proof.
limits: This harness never launches Maestro, ADB, prebuild, install, commit, push or Linear.
npm run test:e2e:release:ti429:local executes only the release-ti429 suite. Other automated checks keep the command listed on the row.
release-native rows target an installed Release binary. mock-native rows use mock fixtures and are not Release-binary proof.
Failed analysis, quota and Plus/guest switching are mock-native. No real purchase.
TalkBack, contrast, large text, reduce motion, localization and mobile/tablet/web formats stay human checks and are unproven until recorded.
A 10_000-character paste is a documented human check because Maestro inputText is not a reliable 10k injector.
Unexecuted automated rows stay blocked in the plan. Manual rows stay manual. Neither is a pass.
Local Jest/typecheck proof is separate from device proof. Device proof stays in a dated maestro-results/android/ti429 directory.

checks.title: Journal list, Trends, weekly recap and recording deep links

checks.notes: Release-native. Covers noctalia://journal (list), noctalia://statistics / Trends, noctalia://weekly-recap and noctalia://recording. Does not cover analysis-ready noctalia://journal/{id}.

checks.title: analysis-ready notification opens journal detail
checks.notes: No stable fixture id: mock local dream ids are timestamps at preload, remoteId is not the journal/[id] route key, and a Release dream id cannot be captured without a device. Exact analysis-ready URL noctalia://journal/{id} requires physical-device proof. Unexecuted = blocked. Not a pass.
checks.evidence: physical-device screenshot of journal/{id} opened from an analysis-ready notification. Missing until a real id is available.

checks.title: TalkBack capture, journal, detail, Trends

checks.title: Contrast on capture, journal, Trends
